exposure: diameter of cervical dilatation < 3 cm when membranes ruptured
time from start of induction to vaginal delivery > 48 hours
cohort: The study included 58 cases of intra-amniotic infection (IAI) patients who underwent induction with single-balloon catheter (SBC) and 464 control women who delivered during the same month without infection after SBC induction.
finding: Nulliparity, BMI > 30 kg/m2, amniotic fluid index (AFI) < 8 cm, diameter of cervical dilatation < 3 cm when membranes ruptured, and time from start of induction to vaginal delivery of more than 48 hours were significantly associated with intra-amniotic infection (IAI) in women undergoing single-balloon catheter induction.
